values.note: RV sites are booked by phone or email (970-884-2641); the online booking engine covers only cabins, apartments and rental RVs. 25% deposit; cancel by 3 pm seven days before arrival for a refund less $10. Holiday periods may require a 3-night minimum.

values.note: 2026 RV sites, all full hookups with cable: 30-amp pull-through or back-in $55-$65 peak (Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day), $44 off-peak; 50-amp and premium 30-amp $59-$69 peak, $47 off-peak (prices climb as the schedule fills); smaller Cozy 30-amp back-ins $44 peak / $39 off-peak. Weekly $264-$282. Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children over 7; $2 per extra person, $3 a day per extra vehicle.

note: Full-service RV park at ~7,800 ft on CR 500 north of Bayfield, on the road up to Vallecito Reservoir (~25 mi from Durango), backing onto San Juan National Forest. Mostly transient, with weekly rates, seasonal Cozy sites by call and park apartments. --Claude
summary: Operator site (Fun Stays LLC): confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups and pull-throughs; added 2026 RV rates ($44 off-peak to $69 peak 50-amp; Cozy back-ins $39-$44), showers/WiFi, rate season Apr 15-Oct 31, phone/email booking with 25% deposit and holiday 3-night minimum. Cleared max_rig_ft 60 (no operator source). Note: dropped the pool/hot tub claim (operator lists neither) and facts now in fields. Presence: site + phone 970-884-2641 match, Google Maps 4.7/256. Price gate: standard 30-amp peak $55 is over US$50, but it is a Good Sam Park (10% off: $49.50) and Cozy sites are $44; no gateway within 40 km, no family stays. Long-stay: nightly rates posted for every site class, so transient in character.
flags: Price gate: the cheapest standard site (30-amp) is $55 peak; it passes only via the Good Sam Park 10% discount ($49.50) or a Cozy back-in ($44 peak) whose length is not published. Off-peak $44-$47.
